incident: DOM-only KPI digits and changes were treated as predictive trend and a made-up 35-95% confidence in Portal V2 nextgen-intelligence. External Tavily ingest independently failed HTTP 432 (usage limit) on 2026-10-19; canonical external snapshot was 10 days old. Runtime sources and company forecasts are different scopes.
root_cause: The future-lens adapter parsed presentational text without tenant-bound measured source refs, time-series/backtest or independently validated model, and manufactured uncertainty. Success of cron request and a fresh snapshot recomputation were not proof that provider observations were fresh.
fix: Read-only Future Lens now refuses DOM-derived numerical forecasts and confidence; only source-referenced, backtested, authenticated tenant forecast payload with recent verification is eligible. Unverified UI shows unknown and links to existing Foresight rather than materializing an action.
prevention: No visible number, score, scenario, evidence claim or monetary value may be synthesized from DOM text or from provider scheduler success. Verify provider response/body and recent authoritative observation timestamp, otherwise report STALE/UNKNOWN; source catalog != connected provider.
